source_text:
15.9
Καὶ ἠγαλλιάσατο ἡ γλῶσσά μου. Γλῶσσαν νῦν λέγει τὸ χάρισμα τοῦ Πνεύ ματος.
pass_a_gloss: And rejoiced the tongue of-me. Tongue now he-says the gift of-the Spirit.
pass_b_english: By tongue he now means the gift of the Spirit.

choices.term: Γλῶσσαν νῦν λέγει τὸ χάρισμα τοῦ Πνεύματος
choices.english: By tongue he now means the gift of the Spirit
choices.why: γλῶσσα here is the Spirit’s charism. Not ‘he now talks about the Spirit’s language’ as a second lemma.
rejected: he now speaks the gift of the Spirit

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
